output.summary: A low-growing herbaceous perennial native to Eurasia, white clover forms spreading mats as its creeping stems root at the nodes. Its leaves almost always have three leaflets, while the whitish flower heads may become tinged pink or cream as they age.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves and flowers are survival food; raw plants are hard to digest, but boiling helps. Avoid flowers long after picking because cyanides may form.
